verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions workflows are defined and executed 'right in your repository' (github-docs-38), so automations sit under the repository's version control. Changes to them can go through GitHub's documented pull-request review workflow (github-docs-69, github-docs-61), including Copilot-assisted review (github-docs-25). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rolling back an automation (revert/restore of workflow versions), evidence that Copilot custom agents or other AI automations are versioned the same way, and independent hands-on corroboration.
